title: Implement Semantic Graph Compression Protocol
objective: Create a Python module in src/graph_compressor.py that takes a NetworkX graph JSON, reduces redundant node clusters based on structural equivalence, and returns the compressed graph. Output must include unit tests in tests/test_graph_compressor.py.

targetOutputs.spec: src/graph_compressor.py and tests/test_graph_compressor.py; the module exposes compress_graph(graph_json: dict) -> dict returning a graph JSON with redundant structurally-equivalent nodes collapsed into representative supernodes, preserving reachability.
